summary.text: Parker Moore is a Republican state representative from Alabama House District 4 who took office in 2018 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election, where Democrat Hanu Karlapalem is also on the ballot. Moore was born in Decatur, Alabama, and worked as a north Alabama marketing representative for Encore Rehabilitation.

paragraphs.text: Moore assumed office in the Alabama House in 2018.

In the 2025-2026 session Moore was vice chair of the Fiscal Responsibility Committee and vice chair of the Limestone County Legislation Committee, and also served on the Boards, Agencies and Commissions Committee and the Transportation, Utilities and Infrastructure Committee.
